mentions.name: Aba Replace
mentions.description: A search-and-replace tool for Windows with incremental grep that shows match results as you type the search pattern. It supports format conversions like Base64, URL encoding, and timestamps, plus one-liners to add width/height attributes to tags or insert file contents.
mentions.source_excerpt: I continue to add more features to my search-and-replace tool for Windows (https://www.abareplace.com/). I initially built in for myself and it was one of the first incremental grep implementations (allowing you to see the results as you are typing the search pattern).
